title: Gate of Salutation, Topkapi Palace
visualBrief: Gate of Salutation (Babusselam) only, first of18 explicitly required Topkapi Palace assets. Specific twin octagonal stone towers/lead spires/finials and upper arched slots/arrow slits, recessed central arch with a genuinely open smaller through-passage, crenellated parapet/corbels, red-brick courtyard elevation and broad low lead-roof canopy on slender columns/pointed arcades. Gently rising occupied paving follows the existing front/rear standard-ground controls. No composite palace, copied calligraphy/tughra/banner artwork, private texture atlas, furnished guard rooms, visitors or movable security equipment.

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Individual Q134728609/Babusselam and OSM way335402649, named Gate of Salutation in the standard20261020 PMTiles. Parent footprint has the two rounded southern tower projections and long courtyard canopy. Internal+X follows the front wall southeast; internal+Z faces the First Courtyard southwest, with the canopy on-Z facing the Second Courtyard. World heading0/native east-south; signed internal axis0.47801027048290257rad. Anchor[28.98323580622673,41.01140314217439]. All other17 principal palace members, exterior walls/gardens/courts, native paths and independent buildings remain separate.
sourceFacts.architecturalHeights: Map footprint has no qualified architectural height. Two actually viewed2015/2023 photos support working tower shafts16.3m/lead tips25.2m, main wall11.9m/crenels13.98m, open portal spring4m/rise2.5m/clear width4.4m, outer recess width9.3m, courtyard colonnade spring6.15m/pointed rise3m/roof up to11.15m. Finial/window/corbel/bay counts and exact profiles are visualization approximations; no fine inscriptions, banner art or ceiling paintings copied. Eight canopy bays/nine front columns are a working picture-led rhythm. Source floor follows a modest1.6158746697761475m rise over45m from the two standard map ground controls, not surveyed thresholds or accessible-route certification.

reconstruction.terrainBasis: Original standard PMTiles/Mapzen terrain retained. Existing front path control internal[-3.9,25] supplies nativeY0; rear control[-3.9,-20] establishes only the occupied paving slope. Rigid towers/walls/roof stay vertical/level; source paving and individual column feet meet the reconstructed slope, with foundations reaching original boundary minima. Terrain opening stays inside the occupied parent floor, including the covered arcade; the true gate passage stays open. No precinct-wide slab or terrain flattening. Native terrain, ownership and load/unload were inspected2026-10-21. Approximate exterior fit accepted; exact thresholds and host terrain accuracy remain outside scope.
